rows.45:2908:
Her fingers were very alluring.
They were delicate, frail fingers, each one looking as if it might start moving on its own, like a separate living creature.
Strangely enough, I think I was calm.
Again, she drew a deep breath.
Then she let it out as a long sigh.{p}
rows.45:309c:
That girl was me.
...Ah.
Akemi Iwashita just killed herself.
Heh heh heh... Serves her right.
She slit her own throat with a box cutter in her own room.
...What a stupid woman.
She killed herself because she was tormented by an evil spirit that doesn't even exist.
...Oh, but maybe I'm the evil spirit.
Hee hee... But you know, I can't pass on unless I get my revenge.
...Do you understand now?
The six who told you scary stories are the children of the six who drove me to suicide.
When I killed myself, my father and mother were heartbroken.
But neither those six nor their parents did anything for us.
They said their children weren't the ones to blame.
You see, the six from back then have grown up and become parents like anyone else.
It's no coincidence that their children all ended up coming to this school together.
It's fate.
They were fated from the very start to be killed by me.
You just happened to serve as their guide along the way.
...All six of them are dead.
Those brats' parents... the six who drove me to my death, will surely grieve.
Just as my father and mother grieved.
{a}.
Do you think what I did was horrible?
Do you think their children weren't to blame?{p}
rows.45:3f50:
"No."
I said it boldly.
After what had happened to Hosoda, I thought it really would be better to do as the masked woman said...
But I couldn't just meekly go along with whatever someone like her told me.
"...I see. I understand. I understand..."
The masked woman murmured it to herself.
She seemed to be repeating my answer in her head, mixing it with her own words and chewing it over.
The masked woman went on.
"Let's play together. Come on, come with me."
It wasn't the stern tone she had used when she was questioning me before.
It was the tone of a child wheedling its parents.
It was a creepy voice, but somehow I might have felt a little calmer than before.
...Just then.{p}
rows.45:42e8:
And directly below me, the masked woman was looking up.
I could tell she was laughing behind her mask...
"In the end... you're... all talk... too... aren't you..."
The masked woman's voice suddenly dropped in pitch, like a stretched tape.
"You... shall be... the guide... leading these six... to hell...
At last... I will... be saved..."
...?
Saved?
What did she mean, saved?
What did she mean by "these six"?
Six... could she mean the people who gathered to tell me these stories?
Had everyone died?
...★
So everyone vanishing meant they had died★
No way...
"These... six... were chosen... from the beginning.
...That too... is... fate.
Now... they are all... waiting... for you to guide them..."
So said the masked woman.
I thought I glimpsed her eyes behind the two thin eye slits of the mask.{p}
rows.45:4bf4:
She had no face.
Or rather, my face was there.
It was me, talking to me.
"...Liar...
It can't be five...
You're lying...
Are you making fun of me?
That's cruel, so cruel☆"
...Even my way of talking and my voice were exactly the same.{p}
rows.45:6b24:
Then she vanished, as if swallowed up by that light.
Where she had stood, the mask she'd been wearing lay, gently set down.{p}
rows.45:8cf0:
...I didn't lay a hand on the ones who drove me to my death.
Instead, I'll be saved by driving their children to their deaths.
I feel as if doing that will wash my ugly, twisted heart clean.
Is that cruel?{p}...Do you think I'm cruel?
rows.45:a374:
"{a}, the time has finally come for me to kill you.
...If only I had been able to kill you back then, maybe I wouldn't have been possessed by an evil spirit..."
As she said it, Iwashita's face looked like an evil spirit itself.
There was no doubt Iwashita was truly possessed by an evil spirit.
"Now, are you ready?
I like you...
But only for choosing me... that is."{p}
